as_told.title: Eric Taber told AARO of egg-shaped craft at Area 51

plain: This story is about an egg-shaped craft said to have been recovered and kept at Area 51, the secret military base in Nevada. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the Daily Mail, a British newspaper, reported on it around 2023. A guest named Merrick tells it a little differently. He says a man named Eric Taber spoke about the egg-shaped craft to AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into UFO reports. Merrick believes Taber placed it at Area 51 but gives no date. If true, it would mean the US military has a recovered unknown craft in its keeping.
